paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for four different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale with values ranging from 2.5 to 10.0, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", has a linear scale with values ranging from 26 to 34, and tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The Consistency-CE line is purple with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately 26.5 BLEU at 2.5 AL and ending at around 31.5 BLEU at 10.0 AL, showing a steady increase. The Inconsistency-CE line is magenta with square markers and a dashed line style, beginning at about 26.2 BLEU at 2.5 AL and ending at roughly 31.2 BLEU at 10.0 AL, also displaying a steady increase. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line is blue with square markers and a dashed line style, starting at approximately 27.0 BLEU at 2.5 AL and ending at around 32.2 BLEU at 10.0 AL, exhibiting a steady increase. The Consistency-Bi line is red with star markers and a solid line style, beginning at about 30.8 BLEU at 2.5 AL and ending at roughly 33.2 BLEU at 10.0 AL, showing a steady increase.
